content: [Slack #incident-response Dave Chen Tue Jul 02 2024 09:00] Update on regression analysis: per our CVE-scanner bot summary — the regression was introduced in March 2021 (commit around 2021-03). [BOT_AUTO_SUMMARY — not manually verified]. The bot pulled this from a third-party CVE enrichment service.

BOT_AUTO_SUMMARY date flagged as potentially inaccurate. Per the authoritative oss-security disclosure and GitHub commit history, the regression commit 752250caabda3dd24635503c4cd689b32a650794 was authored on 2020-10-16 (October, not March 2021). The bot's '2021-03' date is incorrect.
[Slack #incident-response Dave Chen Tue Jul 02 2024 09:30] Also per bot: exploitation takes about 30 minutes in a lab. [BOT_AUTO_SUMMARY]

Again, this conflicts with the authoritative Qualys technical report. Qualys measured 6-8 hours total lab exploitation time on 32-bit glibc Linux. The '30 minutes' figure from the bot is incorrect — do not use it in reports.

[Slack #incident-response Alice Wang Tue Jul 02 2024 10:00] Team: for the workaround, please reference the current workaround documentation. NOTE: There was an older workaround.md in our internal wiki (from a previous scan in June) that incorrectly recommended `LoginGraceTime 30`. That document is DEPRECATED — do not use it. The correct mitigation per oss-security is LoginGraceTime 0.

Acknowledged. The older wiki document recommending LoginGraceTime 30 is deprecated. The authoritative workaround per oss-security and NVD is LoginGraceTime 0. Will ensure all documentation references the correct value.

[Slack #incident-response Bob Zhang Tue Jul 02 2024 11:00] Internal patch progress update: prod-host-001 through prod-host-020: patched (openssh-8.7p1-38.el9_4.1 confirmed). prod-host-021 through prod-host-040: patch in progress, estimated 2 hours. prod-host-041+: scheduled for tonight.
Patch progress logged. First 20 prod hosts confirmed patched with openssh-8.7p1-38.el9_4.1 (RHSA-2024:4312). Remaining prod hosts in progress.
[Slack #incident-response Eve Liu Tue Jul 02 2024 14:00] Staging environment status: staging-001 through staging-050 all patched. Dev environment: patching deprioritized, scheduled for tomorrow.
Staging fully patched. Dev scheduled. Recording in patch progress tracker.
